_readme: Page priorities. 'match' is a regular expression tested against the URL path.
IMPORTANT — read this before changing a weight.
A boost above 1 only applies to a page that is ALREADY nearly winning on
relevance. Specifically, a page must reach boostFloor (default 0.6) of the top
relevance score before any promotion touches it, and the effect then grows as
the square of how close it already was. This is deliberate. An earlier version
of this project applied boosts as a flat multiplier, and the result was that
the boosted CPD page won queries like 'authentic assessment' purely because it
The principle: boosts break ties between relevant results. They never
manufacture relevance. If a page is not relevant to a query, no weight here
should be able to rescue it — and if a page should be relevant but is not, the
fix is a glossary entry or better page content, not a bigger number.
Demotions (weight below 1) apply in full, with no relevance gate. Suppressing
known low-value content needs no hedging.
